answer.justification: The rider has 520 rides with an average duration of 2.74 minutes per ride. Since all rides are on classic bikes (no e-bikes), the pay-per-use cost would be $0.15 per minute, totaling $0.15 * 2.74 * 520 = $219.60. The monthly membership is $10 per month, which is significantly cheaper than the pay-per-use cost for this rider. Additionally, members ride classic bikes free for the first 45 minutes of every ride and pay no unlock fee [P1].
